topography.project_purpose: Infrared Finance is a liquid staking protocol on Berachain and BSC that allows users to stake BERA tokens and receive a liquid staking derivative (iROFT) while earning staking rewards. It also manages fee distribution and bribe collection to optimize yield for stakers.
topography.relationship_narrative: The core staking contracts (InfraredBERAV2_1 and InfraredV1_10) interact with supporting infrastructure: depositor and withdrawor handle user flows, distributor manages reward distribution, fee receivor collects protocol fees, and bribe collector optimizes yield, all sharing the iROFT token.
